mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRX_TASK (ID, CORP_ID, MENU_CD, SRVC_CD, REF_NO, STATUS, CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ, REM_ACCT_NO, BEN_ACCT_NO, BEN_ACCT_NM, TRX_AMT, TRX_CCY_CD, REMARK1, REMARK2, REMARK3, INSTRUCTION_MODE, INSTRUCTION_DT, MAKER_USER_ID, MAKER_USER_NAME, IS_SINGLE_USER, VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{corpId}, #{menuCd}, #{srvcCd}, #{refNo}, #{status}, #{currentStageSeq}, #{remAcctNo}, #{benAcctNo}, #{benAcctNm}, #{trxAmt}, #{trxCcyCd}, #{remark1}, #{remark2}, #{remark3}, #{instructionMode}, SYSDATE, #{makerUserId}, #{makerUserName}, #{isSingleUser}, 0, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TRX_TASK_STAGE (ID, TRX_TASK_ID, SEQ_NO, STAGE_TYPE, APRV_LVL_CD, USR_GRP_OPT, CORP_USR_GRP_ID, REQUIRED_COUNT, COMPLETED_COUNT, STATUS, VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{trxTaskId}, #{seqNo}, #{stageType}, #{aprvLvlCd}, #{usrGrpOpt}, #{corpUsrGrpId}, #{requiredCount}, 0, #{status}, 0, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TRX_TASK_ACTION (ID, TRX_TASK_ID, STAGE_SEQ, ACTION, ACTOR_USER_ID, ACTOR_USER_NAME, ACTOR_GROUP_ID, OTP_VERIFICATION_ID, NOTE, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{trxTaskId}, #{stageSeq}, #{action}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserName}, #{actorGroupId}, #{otpVerificationId}, #{note}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TRX_TASK_CANDIDATE (ID, TRX_TASK_ID, STAGE_SEQ, USER_ID, CORP_USR_ID, USER_NAME, CORP_USR_GRP_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{trxTaskId}, #{stageSeq}, #{userId}, #{corpUsrId}, #{userName}, #{corpUsrGrpId}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id", REF_NO AS "refNo", MENU_CD AS "menuCd", STATUS AS "status", CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ AS "currentStageSeq", TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", REMARK1 AS "remark1", MAKER_USER_NAME AS "makerUserName", CREATED_DT AS "createdDt", VERSION AS "version", CORE_JOURNAL AS "coreJournal", TRX_REF_NO AS "trxRefNo", EXECUTED_DT AS "executedDt" FROM TRX_TASK WHERE CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND ID = #{taskId}

SELECT SEQ_NO AS "seqNo", STAGE_TYPE AS "stageType", APRV_LVL_CD AS "aprvLvlCd", USR_GRP_OPT AS "usrGrpOpt", REQUIRED_COUNT AS "requiredCount", COMPLETED_COUNT AS "completedCount", STATUS AS "status" FROM TRX_TASK_STAGE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY SEQ_NO

SELECT STAGE_SEQ AS "stageSeq", ACTION AS "action", ACTOR_USER_NAME AS "actorUserName", NOTE AS "note", CREATED_DT AS "createdDt" FROM TRX_TASK_ACTION WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY CREATED_DT, ID

SELECT t.ID AS "id", t.REF_NO AS "refNo", t.MENU_CD AS "menuCd", t.STATUS AS "status", t.TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", t.TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", t.REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", t.BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", t.BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", t.REMARK1 AS "remark1", t.MAKER_USER_NAME AS "makerUserName", t.CREATED_DT AS "createdDt", s.SEQ_NO AS "stageSeq", s.STAGE_TYPE AS "stageType", s.REQUIRED_COUNT AS "requiredCount", s.COMPLETED_COUNT AS "completedCount" FROM TRX_TASK t JOIN TRX_TASK_STAGE s ON s.TRX_TASK_ID = t.ID AND s.SEQ_NO = t.CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ AND s.STATUS = N'ACTIVE' JOIN TRX_TASK_CANDIDATE c ON c.TRX_TASK_ID = t.ID AND c.STAGE_SEQ = s.SEQ_NO AND c.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE t.CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND t.STATUS IN (N'PENDING_APPROVAL', N'PENDING_RELEASE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRX_TASK_ACTION a WHERE a.TRX_TASK_ID = t.ID AND a.STAGE_SEQ = s.SEQ_NO AND a.ACTOR_USER_ID = c.CORP_USR_ID) ORDER BY t.CREATED_DT DESC, t.ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ = #{currentStageSeq}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND VERSION = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE TRX_TASK_STAGE SET COMPLETED_COUNT = #{completedCount}, STATUS = #{status}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
UPDATE TRX_TASK_STAGE SET STATUS = #{status}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id", CORP_ID AS "corpId", MENU_CD AS "menuCd", SRVC_CD AS "srvcCd", REF_NO AS "refNo", STATUS AS "status", REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", REMARK1 AS "remark1", MAKER_USER_ID AS "makerUserId", VERSION AS "version" FROM TRX_TASK WHERE ID = #{taskId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = N'EXECUTING', VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND VERSION = #{expectedVersion}
AND STATUS IN (N'READY_TO_EXECUTE', N'QUEUED')

UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = N'EXECUTED', CORE_JOURNAL = #{coreJournal}, TRX_REF_NO = #{trxRefNo}, EXECUTED_DT = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'EXECUTING'
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, EXECUTED_DT = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'EXECUTING'
mapper.select: SELECT ACTOR_USER_ID FROM TRX_TASK_ACTION WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ACTION = N'RELEASE' ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC, ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE TRX_TASK_STAGE SET STATUS = N'CLOSED', VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS IN (N'WAITING', N'ACTIVE')
